name: Goblinslayer
reward: Permanent +1 Attack and Defense vs goblins.
how_to: Take this Milestone, then slay goblins (not hobgoblins). Each goblin's Level adds to your tally (70 total Levels required).

name: Orcslayer
reward: Permanent +1 Attack and Defense vs orcs.
how_to: Take this Milestone, then slay orcs. Each orc's Level adds to your tally (60 total Levels required).

name: Thundermaster
how_to: Take this Milestone, then deal Lightning spell damage totaling 20. At least one Lightning cast must explode (natural 1 on a die).

name: Slumbermaster
how_to: Take this Milestone, then put foes to Sleep. Total Sleep Levels inflicted must reach 100.

name: Scourge of the Hobgoblins
reward: Permanent +1 Attack and Defense vs hobgoblins.
how_to: Take this Milestone, then slay hobgoblins. Each hobgoblin's Level adds to your tally (60 total Levels required).

name: Scourge of the Kobolds
reward: Permanent +1 Attack and Defense vs kobolds.
how_to: Take this Milestone, then slay kobolds. Each kobold's Level adds to your tally (100 total Levels required).

name: Witchfinder
reward: +1 Saves vs spells/curses in witch, hag, or warlock encounters.
how_to: Take this Milestone, then slay witches, hags, or warlocks (10 total slain).

name: Vermin Exterminator
how_to: Take this Milestone, then slay vermin foes (100 total vermin slain).

name: Gaze Resistance
how_to: Take this Milestone, then succeed on 5 Saves vs gaze or petrification attacks while it is active.

name: Scroll Librarian
reward: +1 permanent spell slot for one spell from sacrificed scrolls.
how_to: Take this Milestone, then collect 20 scrolls (tracked when looted). At camp, sacrifice them with Bind grimoire to pick a permanent spell slot.

name: Gem Collector
reward: Craft jewelry worth 150% of gem value between adventures.
how_to: Take this Milestone, then loot 10 gems worth at least 50gp each. At camp, use Craft jewelry (150% combined gem value).

name: Panoplia
reward: Spend 100gp to earn a campaign favor (300gp, ignore fine, jail, or resurrection).
how_to: Take this Milestone, then carry 1 magic weapon, 1 magic shield, and 1 magic body armor. At camp, spend 100gp to style the panoplia and claim a campaign favor.

name: Thrice Blessed
reward: Permanent +1 all Saves after 3 resurrections; pay 10gp × Level before each adventure.
how_to: Take this Milestone, then survive 3 resurrections. After completion, pay 10gp × Level before each adventure for +1 to all Saves.
